create_awq_quantization_recipe: create an AWQ quantization recipe for a MoE model using W4A16 scheme with layer targets
run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a transformer model with a calibration dataset and AWQ recipe
preprocess_chat_dataset: preprocess a chat dataset by applying tokenizer chat templates to message examples
tokenize_calibration_samples: tokenize calibration dataset samples with truncation and max sequence length constraints
save_quantized_model_compressed: save a quantized transformer model and tokenizer to disk in compressed format
